description: Return all ten hosted FBI summarized UCR offense categories for one state and month from LiveDataLink's self-hosted CDE aggregate snapshot, with counts, rates, reporting population coverage, and provenance. Use this for 'FBI crime snapshot for Ohio in June 2022', 'which CDE categories are available for this state-month?', or to inspect coverage before a trend query. Categories overlap and must not be summed; this is not a jurisdiction score, person-level record search, or current incident feed.

month.description: Calendar month in YYYY-MM format within the hosted snapshot.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state or District of Columbia abbreviation; US is not accepted.

name: fbi_cde_state_month_snapshot
